headings: Article preview title (h1, one per article card - NOT a page heading; the logged-in home page has no h1/h2 of its own)
tabs: #<tag> (third tab, hidden until a sidebar tag is clicked)

states.name: populated
states.how: Loaded / with a saved session. 'Global Feed' is active by default and rendered 10 .article-preview cards with pagination [1,2].

states.name: tag-filtered
states.how: Clicked the 'Coding' pill in the Popular Tags sidebar. A pre-existing hidden THIRD tab became visible reading '#Coding' (ion-pound icon + tag text) and took .active; both other tabs lost it. Article list narrowed (10 -> 2 on re-verification) and pagination collapsed to [1]. URL did NOT change - stayed / with no query string (client-side state only). Independently re-verified: feed-toggle innerText became 'Your Feed | Global Feed |  Coding'.

states.name: empty
states.how: Clicked 'Your Feed'. The account follows nobody, so the feed rendered a single .article-preview containing only the verbatim text 'No articles are here... yet.' - no cards, no pagination.

states.name: loading
states.how: Delayed **/api/articles** by 3s via route interception and read the feed 800ms after navigation: a visible element in .col-md-9 shows the verbatim text 'Loading articles...'. The sidebar has a matching (normally hidden) 'Loading tags...' element.

states.name: role-gated:anonymous
states.how: Observed / before authenticating: nav shows Home / Sign in / Sign up instead of New Article / Settings / username, and a .banner hero appears with h1 'conduit' and text 'A place to learn and practice test automation.'. Once logged in the .banner count is 0 - the hero disappears entirely.

states.name: error
states.why: No error surface is reachable read-only on the feed; forcing a 500 from the articles endpoint would require request interception beyond passive crawling.

states.name: disabled/invalid
states.why: No disabled or invalid control exists on the logged-in home feed - every tab, tag pill, favorite button and pagination button is enabled. (The editor surface DOES have an invalid state; it is recorded in views[] below.)

states.name: terminal
states.why: A feed list has no terminal state - it is a browsable index with no completion or end-of-lifecycle condition.

lists.name: Article feed (list of .article-preview cards)

authorAvatarLink.note: image-only link with NO accessible name - href /profile/<author>

favoriteButton.note: accessible name is the COUNT ONLY, prefixed by a space from the ion-heart icon (e.g. ' 2208', ' 0'). This collides with pagination button names - see notes.

previewLink.note: wraps title + description + 'Read more...' + tags, so its accessible name is the whole concatenated card text

title.note: each card contributes an h1; 10 cards = 10 h1 elements

tagPills.note: per-card tags are non-interactive <li> INSIDE the preview link - distinct from the sidebar's <a> pills

rowActions: Open author profile via name link
Open author profile via avatar link

actions.name: New Article
actions.note: accessible name has a LEADING SPACE from the decorative ion-compose icon; non-exact getByRole matching still works, { exact: true } would fail

actions.name: Your Feed
actions.note: NOT role-addressable. Verified live: getByRole('tab') = 0, getByRole('link', { name: 'Global Feed' }) = 0. Must be reached by text scoped into .feed-toggle.

actions.name: Global Feed
actions.note: same constraint; .feed-toggle scoped getByText resolves to exactly 1

actions.name: #<tag> tag tab
actions.state: hidden by default; appears and becomes active after a sidebar tag click
actions.note: The '#' is an icon font, not a literal character - the text is the bare tag name. Exists in the DOM with hidden='' before any tag click, and is re-hidden when another tab is selected.

actions.name: Popular tag pill (sidebar)
actions.note: NOT role-addressable (verified: getByRole('link', { name: 'Coding', exact: true }) = 0). Text is whitespace-padded (' Coding '). CAUTION: getByText('Coding', { exact: true }) matches 3 elements (sidebar pill + in-card tag + tag tab) - MUST scope to .sidebar.

actions.name: Pagination page 1
actions.note: The control's ACTUAL accessible name is the bare digit '1' - it has no aria-label. Named descriptively here so the control is auditable; a screen reader announces only '1', which is itself the accessibility defect recorded as FINDING 6.

actions.name: Pagination page 2
actions.note: Actual accessible name is the bare digit '2'. MUST use exact: true or scope to ul.pagination - verified live that getByRole('button', { name: '2' }) non-exact matches 4 elements (favorite counts ' 2208', ' 247', ' 72' plus this page button).

icons.name: ion-pound (# on tag tab)
icons.region: feed tab row, hidden until a tag is clicked

icons.name: author avatar img
icons.note: wrapped in a profile link with NO accessible name

icons.name: ion-close-round (tag pill remove, editor only)
icons.note: bare <i> with no role, no aria-label, no text - absent from the a11y tree entirely. Must be chained from the pill text via CSS (justifying comment required).

sidebar.heading: Popular Tags
sidebar.headingElement: p (NOT a heading role - verified live that getByRole('heading', { name: 'Popular Tags' }) = 0)

pagination.behaviour: Real <button> elements. Clicking a page replaces the list and moves the active class; the URL never changes. Page count shrinks to ['1'] under a tag filter and pagination is absent entirely in the empty 'Your Feed' state.

views.name: New Article editor
views.openedBy: Click the ' New Article' nav link, or navigate directly to /editor (both verified working)

states.name: empty
states.how: Landed on /editor; all four inputs empty, tag-list renders as an empty div, ul.error-messages renders empty. Publish Article is ENABLED even on an empty form.

states.name: populated
states.how: Filled title/description/body and added two tag pills via Enter; pills rendered in insertion order and the tag input cleared to '' after each Enter. Independently re-verified.

states.name: loading
states.how: Polled the Publish button's disabled property across a submit: [false,true,true,true,false] - transiently disabled ~240ms while the POST is in flight. No spinner, no aria-busy, no overlay.

states.name: error
states.how: Clicked Publish on an EMPTY form. No client-side block: POST /api/articles/ returns 422 {"errors":{"title":["can't be blank"]}}, the page STAYS on /editor and renders exactly ONE <li>: 'title can't be blank'. Errors come one at a time in server field order (title -> description -> body). Independently re-verified: network ['POST 422'], 1 li, text "title can't be blank".

states.name: disabled/invalid
states.how: Publish Article is NEVER disabled by validation - enabled on a pristine empty form and still enabled after a 422. No input carries `required`, none receives ng-invalid, and there is no field-level inline error or aria-invalid. Error text also PERSISTS after correcting the field; it clears only on the next submit.

states.name: terminal
states.how: Published a fully-filled article: redirected to /article/<slug> (slug = title-slugified + '-64987'), the h1 showed the title, the body text rendered in .article-content, and the tag pill appeared on the detail page. Verified end to end, then the probe article was deleted via API.

states.name: role-gated:anonymous
states.why: The editor was crawled only as the authenticated user; logged-out behaviour on /editor was not probed, so it is not claimed.

fields.label: Enter tags
fields.note: NOT an Angular form control - a standalone input whose Enter keypress pushes into a separate tag array. Never blocks submit; a tag left un-entered in the box is discarded.

actions.name: Publish Article
actions.note: Enabled unconditionally, never gated by form validity. Transiently disabled only while POST /api/articles/ is in flight.

opens.behaviour: Typing then Enter appends a removable pill to div.tag-list and clears the input. Verified live with two tags: add both, then remove the first by clicking its ion-close-round icon - the list went from 'alpha beta' to 'beta'.

items.name: <tag text>
items.note: innerHTML is ' '; the pill has NO accessible name and appears in the a11y tree only as flat text

items.name: remove (ion-close-round)
items.note: no role/aria-label/text - reach it as .tag-list .tag-pill filtered by hasText, then the icon class

icons.name: ion-close-round (tag pill remove)
icons.region: inside each tag pill, leading position
icons.note: TESTABILITY GAP - not in the a11y tree at all; requires a CSS chain with a justifying comment

errorContainer.ariaAttributes: NONE - class only. No role, no aria-live, no aria-atomic. role=alert count on the page is 0, so failures are NOT announced assistively (accessibility finding).
errorContainer.messageSemantics: Exactly ONE <li> per failed submit - the server returns only the first failing field, so these three never appear together. ASCII apostrophe in "can't", not typographic.

other.detail: One <form> with 5 <fieldset> elements (outer + four per-field). NO <label> exists anywhere on the surface, so getByLabel() is unusable; getByRole('textbox', { name: <placeholder> }) is the correct primary strategy and was verified to resolve 1 element for all four fields.
Verified by DOM query: 0 select, 0 [role=combobox], 0 tabs, 0 accordions, 0 modals/dialogs, 0 tables, 0 kebab/overflow buttons. A right-click on the form produced 0 menus.
NOT probed: whether Enter on an empty tag input adds a blank pill, and whether duplicate tag names are deduplicated. Flagged rather than asserted.

other.region: top of page, logged out only
other.heading: conduit (h1)
other.text: A place to learn and practice test automation.

other.note: ZERO form controls on the feed surface: input/select/textarea/[role=combobox] count = 0. No search box, no sort dropdown, no filter select - the ONLY filtering affordance is the sidebar tag pills.
Editor submit target (trailing slash). 422 with {"errors":{"<field>":["can't be blank"]}} for blank fields; on success returns the created article and the app redirects to /article/<slug>.
Tag filtering. NOTE: indexing lags - immediately after seeding, a tag query can return 0 and then the article appears. Tests must settle with expect.poll rather than asserting once.

The slug is derived from the title as '<Title-Slugified>-<userId>' (e.g. 'Probe-Publish-mt1i2t7e-64987'). Editing a title through the UI CHANGES the slug, so teardown cannot assume the seeded slug still exists.

The global feed mixes articles from other activity above the fixed Artem Bondar seed articles. Article count, page count and first-card identity are NOT stable - never assert absolute counts or .first() card content.

verifiedAbsent.how: DOM query for table/[role=table]/[role=grid] returned 0 on both the feed and the editor - the feed is a list of div.article-preview cards, recorded under lists[].
'.modal, [role=dialog]' count = 0 on the feed and the editor; a right-click on both surfaces opened no menu. Nothing on either surface opens a dialog.
input/select/textarea/[role=combobox] count = 0 on the logged-in feed - there is genuinely no search, sort or filter control other than the tag pills.
Hovering an article card produced no DOM change (no hidden row actions) and right-clicking opened no menu ([role=menu], .dropdown-menu count = 0), so hasRowMenu is false rather than unlooked-at.

changes: Initial baseline captured (home feed + tag sidebar + pagination, and the /editor sub-view)
Recorded that feed tabs and sidebar tag pills are NOT role-addressable (no href, no role) - locators must scope by text into .feed-toggle / .sidebar
Recorded that editor validation is entirely server-side (422, one error at a time), and that Publish is never disabled

CORRECTION to an initial crawl report: direct page.goto('/editor') does NOT redirect to /. Re-verified twice - the surface loads fine on a hard navigation. The original report's redirect claim was a race in that agent's own login flow, not app behaviour.
